production.note: US model years. First: Jaguar, "Joining the lineup in the United States for the 2022 model year, F-TYPE P450 is the new entry point." Last: Jaguar's 2024 release, "F‑TYPE celebrates the final model year", lists "F-TYPE P450 R-Dynamic RWD" and "F-TYPE P450 75 AWD" (jaguar-us-2024-model-year-highlights). The 2023 model year was not checked individually.

body.note: "New 444hp supercharged V8 P450 coupe and convertible models introduced: rear- and all-wheel drive." The 2024 release: "in both Coupe and Convertible body styles".

configuration.note: Panel: "supercharged and intercooled DOHC 32-valve V-8, aluminum block and heads, direct fuel injection".

displacementL.note: 5,000 cc. Panel: "Displacement: 305 in3, 5000 cm3". Jaguar: "5.0L Supercharged V8 (444 hp / 428 lb-ft)" (jaguar-us-2024-model-year-highlights).

fuel.note: Panel: "direct fuel injection" V-8; no hybrid system.

drivetrain.note: The entry car is rear-wheel drive: "in P450 RWD or P450 R-DYNAMIC AWD trims"; for 2024 "F-TYPE P450 R-Dynamic RWD" and "F-TYPE P450 75 AWD" (jaguar-us-2024-model-year-highlights). All-wheel drive was offered as an option on named trims; the panel car is "front-engine, rear-wheel-drive".

transmission.note: Panel: "TRANSMISSION 8-speed automatic" (Jaguar's eight-speed Quickshift torque-converter automatic). No manual was offered on the V8; Cars.com lists "8-Speed A/T" for the coupe (carscom-2022-f-type-p450-coupe).

powerHp.note: Panel quote: "Power: 444 hp @ 6000 rpm". Manufacturer: "New 444hp supercharged V8 P450 coupe and convertible models introduced" (jaguar-us-2022-f-type-lineup) and, for 2024, "F-TYPE P450 R-Dynamic RWD | 5.0L Supercharged V8 (444 hp / 428 lb-ft)" (jaguar-us-2024-model-year-highlights). Jaguar's 2024 body text says "450HP", the round PS-style figure; the table and all US ratings are 444 hp.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (database). Standard car: 2022 P450 Coupe, RWD. Cars.com "Base Curb Weight" 3,760 lb (single database source). Car and Driver's road-test curb weight, "Curb Weight: 3953 lb" (cd-f-type-p450-2022), is for a 2022 P450 Convertible and so is not used for the coupe; Cars.com lists 3,785 lb for the Convertible RWD (carscom-2022-f-type-p450-convertible).

discrepancies.reason: Body and measurement: Car and Driver's figure is a measured, optioned 2022 Convertible test car; Cars.com's are database base curb weights for the RWD Convertible and Coupe.
discrepancies.resolution: Body: the Car and Driver figure is the Convertible; the Coupe (standard car) figure from Cars.com is used, provisionally.

provisionalNote: Weight (3,760 lb) rests on one database (Cars.com, 2022 Coupe RWD). Jaguar's 2022 US P450 Coupe curb weight (US brochure or JLR media spec sheet) would replace it.
